description: An ancient temple where the four primal elements converge. Once a place of worship, now a battleground where elemental forces rage unchecked.

environment.ambience: crackling energy, howling wind, grinding stone
environment.lighting: shifts between element colors per encounter

encounter_waves.name: Earth Antechamber
encounter_waves.description: The stone floor ripples and rises. Earth elementals coalesce from the walls.

encounter_waves.name: The Furnace
encounter_waves.description: The temperature soars. The air shimmers with heat as fire elementals materialize.

encounter_waves.name: The Frozen Gallery
encounter_waves.description: Ice coats every surface. Your breath crystallizes as ice elementals glide forward.

encounter_waves.name: Storm Chamber
encounter_waves.description: Lightning arcs between metal pillars. The elementals here move with blinding speed.

encounter_waves.name: Elemental Convergence
encounter_waves.description: All four elements clash in a chaotic melee. The room shifts between fire, ice, lightning, and stone.

encounter_waves.name: The Primal Wardens
encounter_waves.description: Two massive elemental wardens block the inner sanctum, each empowered by opposing forces.

encounter_waves.name: The Storm Guardians
encounter_waves.description: The final guardians — elite lightning and earth elementals fused with the sanctum's power.

boss.pre_battle_text: The inner sanctum is a dome of raw elemental energy. At its center, a titanic figure of swirling stone, flame, lightning, and ice slowly turns to face you. The ground cracks beneath its footsteps.
boss.intro_dialogue: Terrakai does not speak. It simply raises one massive fist, and the elements ROAR to life around it.
boss.victory_text: Terrakai shatters into four streams of elemental energy that spiral upward and dissipate through the sanctum's dome. The temple grows still. Balance is restored.
